original_error: v1 source_findings claimed allocation-extent validation, but validate_spans only checks nonnull/alignment/address overflow and disjoint numeric ranges. It never checks the live Allocation registry. The v1 short-output negative test therefore could enqueue an out-of-bounds write; v1 must not be built/executed. This was caught by Main source audit before any native compile or execution.
corrected_implementation: Require all pointers and explicit stream before queue or pointer use.
Require an explicit in-order queue; validate arithmetic spans/overlap, then every state/h/gate/beta/z/gamma/y16 full extent in a live registered device Allocation of that exact queue context/device.
Derive h+2048/h+4096 only after full packed h proof. Preserve owner lifetime requirements: registration check does not retain buffers for async use.
Keep FP32 recurrence/state, FP16 rounding and all barrier/source math unchanged; defaultOFF and no arena saving. Legacy specialization still needs regressions.
